title: Food Delivery Platform
description: A cross-platform food-delivery app for browsing restaurants and menus, building orders, checking out, and tracking couriers live on a map—with a production-ready Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL API and Next.js + Material UI admin platform for restaurants, orders, and couriers.
impact: End-to-end food-delivery product spanning restaurant discovery, cart checkout, live courier tracking, and order timelines across six platforms, backed by a custom API and admin dashboard for restaurant, order, and courier management.
responsibilities: Built restaurant and menu browsing with categories, search, cart placement, and item customizations.
Implemented live order tracking on a map with delivery ETA and an order status timeline from placed to delivered.
Developed address management, reorder shortcuts, and ratings and reviews for restaurants and orders.
Delivered a Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL API with JWT authentication and server-side order totals.
Built a Next.js + Material UI admin platform for restaurants, menus, orders, couriers, and analytics.
achievements: Shipped a cross-platform food-delivery experience for iOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Backed the Flutter client with a full custom backend featuring courier tracking and operational admin tools.
Connected ordering to fulfillment with real-time tracking and end-to-end restaurant and order management.
